de.abas.ceks.jedp.session

Interface BlockingActionMessageListener

  • Functional Interface:
    This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.

    @FunctionalInterface
public interface BlockingActionMessageListener
    Interface to handle server messages indicating that the client shall execute a blocking action. Blocking actions may result from FO commands ".COMMANT -WAIT..." or ".PC.EXEC -WAIT ..." or any other server side feature. All registered BlockingActionListeners get notified if any server feature is requesting a client side action to be processed while server is waiting for it.

    Important note: if a blocking action message is sent by the server, it is waiting for the client until it confirms completion or abortion of the blocking action. Thus, the client must tell the server what to do. If it doesn't, server will wait until the configured timeout has elapsed.

    Author:
    xg
    See Also:
    EDPSessionOption.BLOCKINGACTIONTIMEOUT

    • Method Detail

      • notifyOnBlockingAction

        void notifyOnBlockingAction(BlockingActionMessage blockingAction)
        This method is called for each registered BlockingActionMessage instance when server indicates that a blocking client action should be performed. Client should signal completion or failure of the blocking action using blockingActionFinished or blockingActionAborted.
        Parameters:
        blockingAction - message containing detailed information on the blocking action to be processed
        See Also:
        EDPServerAction.blockingActionFinished(), EDPServerAction.blockingActionAborted()

      • notifyOnBlockingActionFinished

        default void notifyOnBlockingActionFinished(BlockingActionMessage blockingAction)
        This method is called for each registered BlockingActionMessage instance when server indicates that he finished waiting for completion of a blocking client action. Client can use this event to clean up resources for handling blocking actions.
        Parameters:
        blockingAction - message containing information which kind of blocking action it was
        See Also:
        notifyOnBlockingAction(BlockingActionMessage)
